verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so generating financial statements is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow report for an arbitrary period. The evidence covers authentication, contacts, invoicing, payments, tax-authority submission, MCP/CLI/API channels and sandboxes, none of which is about financial-statement reporting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand
